changes.description: Record the Director's D07 decision (2026-10-10): use all planned Disney Lorcana assets, card art and images in full under Ravensburger fan-content terms, with the required notice and no charges for use or access. New current docs/policies/fan-content.md holds the verbatim notice and its placement (README now; web app before any official asset is shown outside local development; published media), plus the no-payment, no-endorsement, per-asset provenance and takedown-readiness rules.

Checked the policy URL in the notice: it resolves to Ravensburger's Community Code PDF (conduct policy, effective 2023-05-10), which does not itself state fan-content permissions or the notice. The brand-portal Fan Content Policy could not be read automatically. This verification gap and the revocation risk (Community Code sole discretion; Pixelborn 2024) are recorded; the decision is the Director's.

Record the BOOT-04 §12 sign-off: all items accepted; purchase-specific items (domain/D01, payment methods, purchase) execute when the first staging deploy is ready. Update the worksheet status/§2/§12, ADR0007 status, BOOT-04 validation, F-STAGING, the backlog status, decision register D02/D03/D07, the AGENTS.md asset boundary, the README notice, the indexes and the handoff.
